hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Each value in the array maps to an index between zero and length minus one.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Negate the value at index abs(x) minus one to mark presence of value x in place.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Positive values remaining in the array correspond to numbers that were never visited.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: In-place sign negation encodes presence without extra memory.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Allocating separate boolean arrays uses O(n) auxiliary space.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Operates strictly in O(1) extra space outside the return list.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies cyclic index sign negation trick for in-place set representation.
